SELECT di.id, di.drug_id, di.hospital_id, di.quantity, di.warning_threshold, di.batch_no, di.expire_date, di.created_at, di.updated_at, d.name AS drug_name, d.code AS drug_code, d.spec, d.unit, h.name AS hospital_name FROM drug_inventory di LEFT JOIN drug_info d ON di.drug_id = d.id LEFT JOIN hospital h ON di.hospital_id = h.id
AND di.drug_id = #{drugId} AND di.hospital_id = #{hospitalId} AND di.quantity <= di.warning_threshold
ORDER BY di.updated_at DESC
